title: The Remnant of a Rotating Regular Black Hole from the Generalized Entropy in the Final Stage of Evaporation
summary: We express the generalized entropy (GE) of the Hawking radiation in the final stage of an evaporating rotating regular black hole (BH) by writing the mass of the BH as $m_{\rm ext} + α$, where $m_{\rm ext}$ represents the mass at the extremal limit and $α$ is a parameter. Generally, entropy is non-negative. Based on this fact, we assume that, in the GE considered in this study, the signs of the contributions from the area term and the correction term remain unchanged throughout the entire evaporation process of the BH.
